description: Department of Census and Statistics - National Consumer Price Index - November 2001
categorisation: This gazette content announces the publication of the National Consumer Price Index for November 2021 by the Department of Census and Statistics. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) and does not fit any of the specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial). This is a statistical announcement that falls under general administrative matters not covered by other categories.
